meta.disclaimer: SYNTHETIC FIXTURE for tests/maintenance/test_evidence_watch.py. Modelled on the 2025 elimination of the clozapine REMS (REMS ended 2025-06-13). Not a verbatim FDA label; contains no dosing.

boxed_warning: WARNING: SEVERE NEUTROPENIA; ORTHOSTATIC HYPOTENSION, BRADYCARDIA, SYNCOPE; SEIZURES; MYOCARDITIS, PERICARDITIS, AND CARDIOMYOPATHY; INCREASED MORTALITY IN ELDERLY PATIENTS WITH DEMENTIA-RELATED PSYCHOSIS. Severe Neutropenia: Clozapine can cause severe neutropenia, which can lead to serious infection and death. Obtain a baseline absolute neutrophil count (ANC) before starting treatment and monitor ANC regularly during treatment.
contraindications: Known serious hypersensitivity to clozapine or any other component of the product.
warnings_and_cautions: Severe Neutropenia: monitor ANC as described in the prescribing information. Orthostatic hypotension, bradycardia and syncope: titrate gradually. Seizures: use caution in patients with a history of seizures.
